hypothesis.statement: On MIT-BIH record 106, classifying the cardiologists' reference beats by prematurity + QRS morphology (ecgDetectPVC) recovers the V (PVC) beats precisely (PPV ~0.99) with high recall on isolated ectopy (F1 ~0.98).

analysis_plan.dataset: MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database record 106, 2027 cardiologist-annotated beats (520 PVCs), MLII @ 360 Hz

decision.threshold: descriptive: PVC detection F1 vs the .atr V labels on the reference beats
